description: Part 10 lesson 10-03, route without RPG III (the old ZA0500 is fixed-form RPG IV, so OBJATTRIBUTE RPGLE cannot tell old from new), issue #35. NOT RUN YET - every expectation is in expected/notes.md and is a prediction. The converted ZA0500 is a HAND conversion (UNVERIFIED) from src/legacy/qrpgle112. WHAT IT DECIDES: which of QSYS2.BOUND_MODULE_INFO, QSYS2.BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO and QSYS2.PROGRAM_INFO can mark old against new. For the old ILE ZA0500, the new SQLRPGLE ZA0500 (solutions/10-03/za0500s.sqlrpgle, ctl-opt bnddir ZAISRVBD, built by CRTSQLRPGI after CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM ZAISRV) and the rolled-back ZA0500 (CRTDUPOBJ from ZA0ORIG) it stores SELECT * copies of the three views (tables VFYBMx, VFYBSx, VFYPIx; WHERE columns PROGRAM_LIBRARY and PROGRAM_NAME are UNVERIFIED guesses, the column lists come from SYSCOLUMNS and from FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS in sh after steps) plus OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED and OBJTEXT. It also checks, for the OLD ILE version, the 12 *TEST lines (compare with part10-03-modernize/expected/golden-test-12.txt), the *LIVE stock (zaikom-live-after.txt) and CPF4123 in the job log (shared open of JUCHUD by JU0900C OVRDBF SHARE(*YES) and OPNQRYF). ORDER: helper compiles, RMVLIBLE of library 1 (TXRNOL), DBVER 1 + RPG III gate, attribute gate, TXLEGACY LANG(*RPGLE) FORCE(*YES), scratch compiles, post-switch gate (else RSTLEG), TXRESET, ticket-1 fix (JU0900T1), OLD snapshot and runs, TXRESET, backup ZA0ORIG in the B library (BKGUARD jumps to RSTLEG when missing), new ZA0500, NEW snapshot and runs, TXRESET, rollback, ROLL snapshot and run, then RSTLEG: TXLEGACY LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*YES), TXRESET, final-state rows. ZAISRV, ZAISRVBD and the QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC members stay in the library (they are rebuilt with REPLACE). Wrapper name TPART1003R. Recovery by hand if the run stops: see expected/notes.md.
